audioPublication.auditMethod: Hosted Python scan of both complete PCM16 WAV files: receipt SHA-256 and byte count, mono PCM16 RIFF structure, sample rate, sample count and full PCM16 data digest; streamed exact-constant runs tracked across read-block boundaries; Wav2Vec2/torchaudio 2.6.0 transcribed first and last 15 seconds.
audioPublication.pcmHashNote: The result receipt pcmSha256 hashes the browser Float32 PCM. wavPcm16DataSha256 hashes the lossy PCM16 WAV payload; these are different encodings and are intentionally recorded separately.
audioPublication.transcriptLimit: Edge transcripts are a limited intelligibility check, not full-article word-accuracy proof or a subjective listening review.
